notes: PR-0.1 Checkpoint B7.4C: B7.4B verdict corrected to BLOCKED because the
authorized controlled pilot is an approved-user, read-only AURA
experience and five public routes do not constitute that pilot.
Onboarding (/onboarding) is reclassified from public-pilot to
write-deferred: it performs a supabase.from('onboarding_submissions')
INSERT and therefore is not a read-only public-pilot route. Password
recovery is split honestly: /forgot-password is a recovery-entry page,
operable. Approved-user pilot capability is BLOCKED: no existing
approved-user route can be loaded without either mounting Layout
(which initializes Copilot, Zapier, health probes and search
suggestions) or invoking blocked edge functions (ai-systems-unified,
systems-delete on Dashboard). Building the approved-user surface
would require new overview / inspection pages and a pilot-safe layout
shell; that is an architectural expansion beyond decoupling and is
not authorized in B7.4C. No function is allowlisted.
Adding a production function REQUIRES: (1) _shared/authz.ts guard
imported and exercised; (2) explicit is_approved + role check;
(3) explicit CORS origin; (4) request schema validation;
(5) sanitized error envelopes; (6) inventory disposition set to
'production-allowlisted'.
B7.4E: Adds a single approved-user pilot splat route (/pilot/*) to
production_routes. The splat mounts src/pilot/PilotShell.tsx OUTSIDE
the shared <Layout>; PilotShell nests /pilot/overview and
/pilot/asset/:twinId which serve read-only projections of
public.data_centre_twins and public.twin_kpi_snapshots gated by
existing owner-scoped RLS. No edge function is invoked; the
production_functions allowlist remains empty.
Evidence Beta (/dsx/evidence-beta) is an authenticated, local-only, zero-edge-function DSX evidence workspace. It is classified production_blocked until the disposable-environment gate passes.

B7.5 perimeter reconciliation: the promotion gate previously required an import of _shared/authz.ts, a module that does not exist, so no function could ever be promoted. Rule 3 of scripts/verify-production-perimeter.mjs now requires a real in-code guard: either _shared/handler.ts createHandler with an explicit non-public authLevel, or _shared/callerIdentity.ts / _shared/adminAuthorization.ts together with the scoped _shared/cors.ts origin allowlist. This is strictly more verification than before, not less.

B7.5 promotion basis: only edge functions actually invoked from src/ (46 of 170) were considered. The 20 promoted functions are the subset that both appear in that call graph and satisfy the guard requirement above. Everything else stays unknown-blocked under default-deny. Not promoted: public-intake (anonymous intake, outside the perimeter), dsx-ingest (verify_jwt=false, remains signed-webhook), green-dc-recommend and generate-ai-recommendations (disabled), and every function whose handler declares authLevel 'public'.

B7.5 route classification: rules 6 and 8 previously scanned only src/App.tsx, which now declares a single route, leaving the shipped router unenforced. The scan now also covers src/PublicAppRoutes.tsx and src/AuthenticatedShell.tsx. The 23 routes surfaced by that change are classified production_blocked_routes; promoting them is deferred to a separate checkpoint, so promoting a function here does not implicitly open its calling route.

2026-08-23 post-publish hardening: promoted shipped authenticated product routes; aliases reconciled against src/config/routeAliases.ts; agent-stream promoted (createHandler authLevel:"authenticated" + shared CORS). Dev/debug/demo surfaces (/twin-debug, /digital-twins-demo/funding-intake, /admin/asset-*, /blueprint/preview, /simulation/preview) remain blocked.
alias_production_exceptions: "/" and "/forgot-password" are shipped public routes that additionally redirect authenticated sessions to /dashboard.

2026-08-24 enterprise remediation: /admin/customers is classified as a production platform-administration route. Cross-tenant inventory is served by platform_list_organizations(), a SECURITY DEFINER RPC that independently requires an approved profile plus a live global owner grant. Customer provisioning and owner-invite recovery reuse the existing guarded teams-invite function; no new Edge Function inventory entry is introduced.

2026-08-24 enterprise edge promotion: teams-invite is promoted through edge-function-promotions.json. The perimeter overlays only explicit production-allowlisted promotions onto the historical inventory, rejects malformed/unknown/duplicate promotions, and independently re-verifies the actual caller-identity plus scoped-CORS source guard and gateway JWT setting.

2026-08-24 neutral-route reconciliation: the shipped router now uses /evidence as the provider-neutral authenticated evidence workspace and /admin/accelerated-ai-capabilities as the canonical admin capability route. Flat /evidence compatibility paths and /dsx/evidence-beta/* are redirects only. /admin/dsx-capabilities is also redirect-only. This classification change promotes no Edge Function and preserves default-deny route enforcement.

2026-08-24 P1 Batch B route promotion: /blueprint/preview and /simulation/preview are authenticated read-only recommendation previews whose displays are now restricted to recommendation-backed planning values and committed scenario metadata. /studio/systems/:systemId/manage remains protected by twin.edit and now preserves missing runtime/configuration evidence instead of fabricating capability or metric claims. No new Edge Function is promoted by this checkpoint.

2026-08-24 P1 Batch C governance: /infrastructure is compiled and routed only when import.meta.env.DEV is true, and its source remains a mock/reference page. It is therefore development-only rather than a production route. The canonical /admin/accelerated-ai-capabilities surface uses provider-neutral presentation while retaining source-controlled evidence mappings internally.

2026-08-26 release reconciliation: /reset-password is the shipped recovery-completion route and /readiness/supervisor is the authenticated supervisor-readiness route. Both are explicitly classified without changing their existing guards or the default-deny policy.

2026-08-26 post-release smoke correction: /infrastructure remains non-canonical and its illustrative mock page remains excluded from production; the legacy URL is classified redirect-only and resolves to the tenant-bound /evidence/assets workspace.

2026-08-27 perimeter exclusion: /blueprint/preview and /simulation/preview are reclassified from production_routes to production_blocked_routes. They remain authenticated, permission-guarded recommendation previews in the shipped router, but they are excluded from the production perimeter and are not part of the qualified production surface. No Edge Function classification changes; the production_functions allowlist is unchanged.

2026-09-01 perimeter drift correction: ai-config was already explicitly promoted by edge-function-promotions.json after independent caller authentication, scoped CORS, gateway JWT verification, read-only behavior, and server-owned provider-neutral output were reviewed. It is now present in production_functions so the effective allowlist matches the governed promotion ledger.
